title: The Arms Merchants
description: The Arms Merchants — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Deward the Arms Merchant

Quest Type: Talk

Quest Description: There are three weapon and armor merchants in Townston. Speak with each.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Deward the Arms Merchant

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: The Arms Merchants

Zone: Townston

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: There are three weapon and armor merchants in Townston. Speak with each.

Offer:

Hail! Art thou the hero the guards speak of? The pleasure of our meeting is all mine. If thou needeth more refined equipment for thou's adventures, do take a gander at my sales.

Alas, a day will arive when I will not be able to provide thee with the gear thee requires. When that day comes, thou will needeth to take thee's gold unto Deward, the Better Arms Merchant. Deward wilt be found Northeast from here. Do walk past the Obelisk and follow the path up the hill. I pray you, go find him now! Thus, thou will not be left out in the cold when I cut you off.

Turn-in:

Hughard sent thee, you say? He is like a brother to me... Well, here I am, so now ye knows. If ye seek to become a legendary Dungeon Runner, then ye will eventually needeth my goods.

Client level range: 1–10
